<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>Implement a 4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplicand.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="partial_products" width_description="[2*size-1:0]">Array to store partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="registers" width_description="[2*size-1:0]">Array to store intermediate sum values.</reg>
        <reg id="product" width_description="[2*size-1:0]">Product accumulator.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <!-- Multiplication operation -->
        <for>
            <from>0</from>
            <to>size-1</to>
            <do>
                <if>
                    <true>partial_products[i] = mul_a << i;</true>
                    <false>partial_products[i] = 'd0;</false>
                </if>
            </do>
        </for>
        <!-- Add of partial products -->
        <for>
            <from>0</from>
            <to>size/2-1</to>
            <do>
                <if>
                    <true>registers[i] <= partial_products[2*i] + partial_products[2*i+1];</true>
                    <false>registers[i] <= 'd0;</false>
                </if>
            </do>
        </for>
        <!-- Final product calculation -->
        <always>
            <trigger>
                <true>clk posedge or rst_n negedge</true>
            </trigger>
            <do>
                <if>
                    <true>rst_n == 0, product <= 0;</true>
                    <false>product <= registers;</false>
                </if>
            </do>
        </always>
        <assign>
            <lhs>mul_out</lhs>
            <rhs>product</rhs>
        </assign>
    </implementation>
</module>
